svg.text: Source: A | Finding shortest paths to all nodes | Green = visited, Orange = current, White = unvisited
2. Select unvisited node with smallest tentative distance → mark as current
3. Update distances of unvisited neighbors: d(neighbor) = min(d(neighbor), d(current) + weight)
4. Mark current as visited → repeat from step 2
5. Stop when all nodes visited or destination reached
Time complexity: O(V²) or O((V+E) log V) with min-heap
